31914-the-story-of-general-pershing.title: The Story Of General Pershing
31914-the-story-of-general-pershing.creator: Everett T. Tomlinson
31914-the-story-of-general-pershing.description: A book by Everett T. Tomlinson. THE morning of June 13, 1917, was one of the historic mornings in the history of the world. On the landing dock at Boulogne, France, a detachment of French infantry was drawn up in line. The men were clad in the uniform of battle. Their faces confirmed the report that recently they had seen hard service in the trenches--as they had.

77150-colour-in-woven-design.title: (Woollen, Worsted, Cotton And Silk Materials)
77150-colour-in-woven-design.creator: Unknown
77150-colour-in-woven-design.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Three years ago the first edition of my work on _Woollen and Worsted Cloth Manufacture_ appeared, and in the preface of the book I observed that should it be satisfactorily appreciated I would write other treatises on specific branches of textile designing and weaving.

arxiv-2301-10791.title: Flavor Leptogenesis During Reheating Era
arxiv-2301-10791.creator: Arghyajit Datta, Rishav Roshan, Arunansu Sil
arxiv-2301-10791.description: Abstract Recently, it has been shown that the presence of a non-instantaneous era of reheating can significantly alter the charged lepton(s) equilibration temperature(s) which plays important role in flavor leptogenesis. In this work, we extend the analysis to a more general situation where RHNs are also produced from the decay of the inflaton.

arxiv-2304-10497.title: Near-field diffraction of protons by a nanostructured metallic grating under external electric field: Asymmetry and sidebands in Talbot self-imaging
arxiv-2304-10497.creator: Sushanta Barman, Sudeep Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2304-10497.description: Abstract Self-imaging in near-field diffraction is a practical application of coherent manipulation of matter waves in Talbot interferometry. In this work, near-field diffraction of protons by a nanostructured metallic grating under the influence of (a) uniform, (b) spatially modulated, and (c) temporally modulated electric fields are investigated.

arxiv-2312-14144.title: Optical Quasi-periodic Oscillations in the TESS light curves of three blazars 2023 Optical Quasi-periodic Oscillations in the TESS light curves of three blazars –
arxiv-2312-14144.creator: Ashutosh Tripathi, Krista Lynne Smith, Paul J. Wiita, Robert V. Wagoner
arxiv-2312-14144.description: Abstract We report the time series analysis of TESS light curves of three blazars, BL Lacertae, 1RXS J111741.0+254858, and 1RXS J004519.6+212735, obtained using a customized approach for extracting AGN light curves. We find tentative evidence for quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in these light curves that range from 2 to 6 days.

arxiv-2312-16652.creator: Omar I. Al-Bataineh
arxiv-2312-16652.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Omar I. Al-Bataineh. This paper describes a formal general-purpose automated program repair (APR) framework based on the concept of program invariants. In the presented repair framework, the execution traces of a defected program are dynamically analyzed to infer specifications φ c ​ o ​ r ​ r ​ e ​ c ​ t \varphi_{correct} and φ v ​ i ​ o ​ l ​ a ​ t ​ e ​ d \varphi_{violated} , where φ c ​ o ​ r ​ r ​ e

arxiv-2403-00539.title: DyPyBench: A Benchmark of Executable Python Software
arxiv-2403-00539.creator: Islem Bouzenia, Bajaj Piyush Krishan, Michael Pradel
arxiv-2403-00539.description: Abstract . Python has emerged as one of the most popular programming languages, extensively utilized in domains such as machine learning, data analysis, and web applications. Python’s dynamic nature and extensive usage make it an attractive candidate for dynamic program analysis.

arxiv-2403-08423.title: Gluonic gravitational form factors of the proton
arxiv-2403-08423.description: Abstract The gravitational form factors (GFFs) are a fundamental and elegant way to describe the structure of nucleons and nuclei. Their Fourier transform allow a description of the spatial distribution of the mass, angular momentum, pressure and shear force densities for both quarks and gluons in the nucleon.

arxiv-2403-09680.title: Pre-Sorted Tsetlin Machine (The Genetic K-Medoid Method)
arxiv-2403-09680.creator: Jordan Morris, Alex Yakovlev
arxiv-2403-09680.description: Abstract This paper proposes a machine learning pre-sort stage to traditional supervised learning using Tsetlin Machines. Initially, K data-points are identified from the dataset using an expedited genetic algorithm to solve the maximum dispersion problem. These are then used as the initial placement to run the K-Medoid clustering algorithm.

arxiv-2403-15652.title: Parametric Encoding with Attention and Convolution Mitigate Spectral Bias of Neural Partial Differential Equation Solvers
arxiv-2403-15652.creator: Mehdi Shishehbor, Shirin Hosseinmardi, Ramin Bostanabad
arxiv-2403-15652.description: Abstract Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) are increasingly used to solve partial differential equations (PDEs) that naturally arise while modeling a wide range of systems and physical phenomena. However, the accuracy of such DNNs decreases as the PDE complexity increases and they also suffer from spectral bias as they tend to learn the low-frequency solution characteristics.

arxiv-2508-19711.title: Prototyping of 6.2-mm-Pitch Fiber Positioner Modules for Stage-V Telescope Instrumentation
arxiv-2508-19711.creator: Malak Galal, Maxime Rombach, Jonathan Wei, Ricardo Araújo, Diane Chapuis, Sébastien Pernecker, Abby Bault, Joseph Harry Silber, Nicholas Wenner, William Van Shourt, Stefane Caseiro, Corentin Magnenat, David Schlegel, Jean-Paul Kneib
arxiv-2508-19711.description: Abstract Small-pitch populated focal planes are a critical enabling technology for the next generation of highly multiplexed astronomical instruments. This work reports on ongoing prototyping activities for 6.2 mm-pitch alpha–beta (theta–phi) fiber positioner modules. Following a concise review of the underlying concept, the performance of trillium-based and independently actuated robotic designs is compared.

arxiv-2511-16037.title: LLMs-based Augmentation for Domain Adaptation in Long-tailed Food Datasets
arxiv-2511-16037.creator: Qing Wang, Chong-Wah Ngo, Ee-Peng Lim, Qianru Sun
arxiv-2511-16037.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Qing Wang, Chong-Wah Ngo, Ee-Peng Lim, Qianru Sun. Training a model for food recognition is challenging because the training samples, which are typically crawled from the Internet, are visually different from the pictures captured by users in the free-living environment. In addition to this domain-shift problem, the real-world food datasets tend to be long-tailed distributed and some dishes of different categories exhibit subtle variations that are difficult to distinguish visually.

pmc-10667887.title: Hydrocele of the Canal of Nuck: A report of five cases
pmc-10667887.creator: Shankar Adhikari, Om Prakash Bhatta
pmc-10667887.description: Introduction and importanceCanal of Nuck hydrocele is a rare condition in females. Due to mild symptoms, it may be neglected, leading to complications, including infection and bleeding. The rarity of this condition, coupled with its potential for adverse outcomes, necessitates a high index of suspicion among treating surgeons to diagnose and promptly manage the case.

pmc-11487932.title: Decoupling Variable Capacitance and Diffusive Components of Active Solid–Liquid Interfaces with Flex Points
pmc-11487932.creator: Liam Deehan, Ajeet Kumar Kaushik, Ganga Ram Chaudhary, Pagona Papakonstantinou, Nikhil Bhalla
pmc-11487932.description: Understanding the current transport characteristics of electrode interfaces is essential for optimizing device performance across a wide range of applications including bio-/chemical sensing and energy storage sectors. Cyclic voltammetry (CV) is a popular method for studying interfacial properties, particularly those involving redox systems. However, it remains challenging to differentiate between electron movements that contribute to capacitive and diffusive behaviors.

pmc-11654163.title: The relationship between food components and constipation: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11654163.creator: Yuhan Xu, Zengfu Xue
pmc-11654163.description: BackgroundThe worldwide incidence of constipation is exhibiting an increasing trend. The objective of this study was to assess the relationship between dietary components and the occurrence of constipation.MethodsSociodemographic characteristics data of participants experiencing constipation and those without were sourced from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES; 2000–2010; n = 1903; ≥20 years).

pmc-12654340.title: Microbial Community Restructuring and Functional Response in Giant Duckweed (Spirodela polyrhiza) Fronds Driven by Cadmium Stress
pmc-12654340.creator: Bingliang Liu, Chen Yang, Xin Wan, Suming Chen, Yang Tao, Qiang Li, Hai Zhao, Xinhui Wang
pmc-12654340.description: As a typical heavy metal pollutant, cadmium (Cd) poses significant threats to ecosystems and human health. Giant duckweed (Spirodela polyrhiza), a small aquatic plant characterized by rapid growth and efficient heavy metal accumulation, holds great promise for phytoremediation. However, the mechanisms by which S. polyrhiza enriches Cd—particularly the contributions of its surface-associated microbiota—remain poorly understood. In this study, S.

pmc-12882132.title: Effects of different additives and chopping lengths on the biosafety of Sophora Davidii silage
pmc-12882132.creator: Shihao Liu, Ning Mao, Ermei Du, Zhengrong Deng, Shangxiong Zhang, Hanyu Zhang, Meiling Fan, Juan Chen, Haiyan Yin, Yulong Zheng, Hong Sun, Fuyu Yang, Yixiao Xie
pmc-12882132.description: BackgroundAntibiotic resistance genes (ARGs), mobile genetic elements (MGEs), and virulence factors (VFs) represent growing threats to global public health. Sophora davidii silage is a common feed in livestock production, may potentially serve as a reservoir and vector for the dissemination of these genetic determinants. The biosafety risks associated with Sophora davidii silage remain poorly evaluated.

pmc-13128581.title: Health literacy on tuberculosis prevention and control among people living with HIV: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13128581.creator: Mingkuan Fan, Xia Yuan, Chuangui Nie, Xian Wang, Wen Cheng, Qiangxiang Zhang
pmc-13128581.description: BackgroundTuberculosis (TB) remains a severe public health threat in China. People living with HIV (PLWH) face markedly higher risks of TB and TB-related mortality. Evaluating TB knowledge in this vulnerable group is critical for targeted health education, yet relevant data remain scarce. This study assessed TB awareness among PLWH to inform tailored TB health-education interventions.

pmc-13178597.title: Green-synthesized zeolite Y-supported zero-valent iron nanocomposite for enhanced adsorptive reduction of hexavalent chromium from aqueous solutions
pmc-13178597.creator: Nur Fariha Mahmuda, Yanuardi Raharjo, Tokok Adiarto, Handoko Darmokoesoemo, Heru Pramono, Ahmad Fauzi Ismail
pmc-13178597.description: Hexavalent chromium (Cr(vi)), a major pollutant in tannery wastewater, poses significant environmental and health risks. Zeolite Y possesses a high cation-exchange capacity but low affinity for Cr(vi), which predominantly exists in anionic forms in aqueous solutions. This study aimed to modify zeolite Y with zero-valent iron nanoparticles (nZVI) to enhance its capacity to adsorb Cr(vi).

pmc-13240289.title: Prenatal Diagnosis of Short Rib‐Polydactyly Syndrome (SRPS), DYNC2I1‐Related: Identification of a Novel Homozygous Missense Variant by Clinical Exome Sequencing
pmc-13240289.creator: Shiyao Xian, Qi Zhao, Yanfang Li, Lihua Li, Zhongwei Li, Miaolian Zhang, Suihua Feng, Qiang Zhao
pmc-13240289.description: Short rib‐polydactyly syndrome (SRPS), with or without polydactyly, encompasses a range of autosomal recessive skeletal dysplasias characterized by shortened limbs, narrow thorax, and visceral abnormalities. Accurate genetic testing is crucial for the diagnosis and treatment of different clinical subtypes. This study investigates gene variants associated with the clinical features in a Chinese family affected by short rib‐polydactyly syndrome (SRPS), DYNC2I1‐related.

pmc-13263875.title: Correlation between reproductive hormone levels and genetic abnormalities in patients with non-obstructive azoospermia and oligospermia
pmc-13263875.creator: Yuhe Fu, Liang Hu, Jinxing Liu, Yuanyuan Pei, Xiaojin Luo, Jiangtao Bai, Weiqiang Liu
pmc-13263875.description: BackgroundAlthough male infertility has been studied extensively, the relationship between genetic abnormalities and reproductive hormone levels remains to be explored. This study investigates the causes of non-obstructive azoospermia and oligospermia, focusing on their association with sperm concentration, reproductive hormone levels, and genetic factors.

pmc-13329009.title: Comments on “Prevalence, patient characteristics and outcomes of high-dose upadacitinib in inflammatory bowel disease”
pmc-13329009.creator: Aliza Altaf, Fiza Memon, Lavish Kumar
pmc-13329009.description: hors should be commended for their valuable real-world investigation, offering important insights on the efficacy and safety of high-dose upadacitinib in a particularly challenging patient population. However, we would like to raise two points which could further strengthen the interpretation of the findings.

pmc-13351217.title: A retrospective observational analysis of the global burden of smoking-attributable prostate, bladder, and kidney cancers among adults aged 40 years and older: Based on the global burden of disease study 2021 with projections to 2045
pmc-13351217.creator: Naiwen Chen, Jinming Cai, Jinpeng Feng, Yi He, Dongliang Xu
pmc-13351217.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveSmoking remains a significant risk factor for prostate, bladder, and kidney cancers. The disease burden and smoking-attributable carcinogenic effects are particularly concentrated in adults aged 40 years and older, making this age group critical for targeted prevention.

pmc-13428483.title: Epidemiology of Incidence and Mortality Due to Head and Neck Cancer in Poland in 2000 to 2022
pmc-13428483.creator: Patrycja Zaborska, Jurek Olszewski, Piotr Henryk Skarżyński

pmc-13516517.title: Biomimetic ZIF-8 Nanoplatform for Enhanced Therapeutic Efficacy of Combined Phototherapy and Chemotherapy Against Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-13516517.creator: Xinlei Lin, Shaoteng Huang, Ning Zheng, Wenjie Yao, Mingbo Zhang, Qingqing Tu, Longhua Shen, Tao Wang, Gang Niu, Fang Wang, Junyang Zhuang, Yang Chen, Ning Li
pmc-13516517.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains challenging to treat because of the limited therapeutic efficacy and insufficient selectivity of conventional therapies. To overcome these limitations, multifunctional nanoplatforms integrating biomimetic strategies and combination therapy have attracted increasing attention. Single-modality therapies are often limited by insufficient therapeutic efficacy and restricted mechanisms of action, highlighting the need for biomimetic nanoplatforms that integrate combination therapeutic strategies for enhanced antitumor performance.

pmc-13551769.title: Anesthetic management and obstetric outcome for open fetal myelomeningocele repair at a Japanese center: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13551769.creator: Saya Nagata, Yu Matsumoto, Akira Iura, Takeshi Yoshida

pmc-13641853.title: Fixação combinada intramedular-externa com fios de Kirschner para fraturas das falanges: Descrição de técnica cirúrgica
pmc-13641853.creator: Gabriel Ifran Alves, Antônio Lourenço Severo, Marcelo Barretos de Lemos, Osvandré Lech, Felipe Kowaleski, Ivânio Tagliari
pmc-13641853.description: ResumoA mobilização precoce é fundamental para a recuperação funcional após fraturas das falanges, mas muitos métodos de fixação ainda exigem imobilização prolongada, o que aumenta o risco de rigidez articular. Descrevemos uma técnica simples, segura e de baixo custo, que combina fios de Kirschner intramedulares e ligação externa, adaptada do método de Ulson, originalmente desenvolvido para fraturas do rádio distal.

pmc-13651113.title: Comparing and combining O-RADS ultrasound, serum CA125, and HE4 for the preoperative diagnosis of ovarian tumors
pmc-13651113.creator: Jingjing Gong, Keting Li, Yujie Liu, Min Ren
pmc-13651113.description: BackgroundAccurate preoperative differentiation between benign and malignant ovarian tumors is critical for optimal patient management. The Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS) ultrasound risk stratification and serum biomarkers like CA125 and HE4 are key diagnostic tools, but their comparative and combined efficacy, especially when stratified by menopausal status, warrants further investigation.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A tribe or tribal corporation to which a loan is made or insured pursuant to sections 5136 to 5143 of this title (1) may waive in writing any immunity from suit or liability which it may possess, (2) may mortgage or otherwise.
